name: RING1 and YY1 binding protein

function.text: RYBP encodes RING1 and YY1-binding protein. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and transcription corepressor activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.
